what: WORKED COMPUTATION (independent run 2 of 2): The light-cone formation kernel, exactly. Event lattice in 3+1 with symmetric predecessors: the record at (t+1, x) is formed from (t, x) and (t, x +- e_j), seven predecessors. Linear gain-one model: theta_{t+1} = P theta_t + noise, phi(k) = (1 + 2 sum_j cos k_j)/7. (1) Show phi = 1 - E(k)/7 with E(k) = 2 sum_j (1 - cos k_j) and the stationary equal-time covariance sigma^2/(1 - phi^2) = 7 sigma^2/(2 E(k) (1 - E(k)/14)), sigma^2 = A(7 beta)/(7 beta): the lattice Green-function kernel 1/E(k) times a factor between 1 and 7 on the Brillouin zone (give its exact range; note phi = -5/7 at the zone corner). (2) Real space: C(x) = (7 sigma^2/2) G(x) + correction, G the Z^3 lattice Green function; bound the correction's decay (it is short-ranged: show exponential or 1/r^3 and say which). (3) The space-time covariance sigma^2 phi^s/(1 - phi^2): no drift, decay rate E(k)/7 per level. (4) Verify (1) and (3) exactly on L = 3, 4 tori by propagating the covariance with rational arithmetic, and (2) numerically by FFT at L = 64, 128. Expectation: all four hold. DELIVERABLE in your unit worktree: probes/work/compute/lightcone-kernel-exact/<your worker name>/run.py (self-contained; exact arithmetic wherever the statement is exact; numpy only for the numerical cross-checks named) and RESULT.md (the table or formulas, in plain text). run.py prints one line per result, a final `SUMMARY: <the main result in one line>`, and `HIT: <what>` ONLY if a result contradicts the expectation stated in the task (that is the interesting case: report it precisely). Two workers do each computation independently; the supervisor compares them. Run: python3 probes/run_probe.py <task> --worker <name> --model <model> --review "..." --extra "python3 probes/work/compute/lightcone-kernel-exact/<name>/run.py"
